settings.title: Algorithm & Profile Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize your FSRS v5 engine parameters, manage your user identity, and sync your progress in Supabase.
settings.language_section_desc: Choose the interface language and the language of AI-generated flashcards.
settings.fsrs_section_title: FSRS Engine Parameters (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler)
settings.fsrs_section_desc: FSRS models memory stability and card difficulty to schedule optimal review intervals according to your retention targets.
settings.retention_desc: Target probability of recalling the card at the exact review moment.
settings.retention_guide_light: Light study load: You will save daily study time, but forget approximately 15% to 30% of your cards.
settings.retention_guide_balanced: FSRS recommended balance: Maximizes cognitive efficiency with excellent long-term retention without review overload.
settings.retention_guide_demanding: High intensity: Ideal for dense exams or imminent certifications. Daily reviews will increase significantly.
settings.max_interval_desc: The maximum number of days that FSRS can space a card into the future.
settings.fuzz_desc: Adds a subtle random variation to intervals to prevent hundreds of cards from clustering on the same day.
settings.profile_section_desc: Linked to your unique user ID in Supabase with strict RLS security policies.

exam.hero_description: Assess your knowledge under real exam conditions with a global timer and blind scoring. This simulation is independent and does not alter your FSRS memory algorithms.
exam.penalty_none_desc: Wrong answers do not deduct points
exam.format_all_desc: Multiple choice, True/False, Cloze and Open-ended
exam.help_blind_desc: Answer all questions without instant feedback. Final score and detailed solutions are revealed once the exam is completed, simulating real test conditions.
exam.help_format_desc: Select options directly for Quiz and True/False. For basic and cloze questions, you can type your answer; at the end you compare it with the solution to confirm success or mistake.
exam.help_penalty_desc: You can enable official penalty systems (-1/3 or -1/4 per mistake). Unanswered questions do not deduct points. Final grade is calculated on a 10-point scale.
exam.help_integrity_desc: This mock exam is 100% independent. It never modifies your FSRS intervals, review logs, or daily study streak.
exam.typed_answer_placeholder: Write your answer here to compare with the official solution upon completion...
exam.confirm_finish_desc: Your final score will be calculated with recorded answers. Unanswered questions will count as blank.
exam.self_eval_desc: Compare what you wrote with the official solution for each flashcard to honestly mark whether you were correct.
exam.passed_comment: Excellent mastery! You passed the mock evaluation successfully.
exam.failed_comment: You did not reach 5.0 this time. Review the detailed solutions below to reinforce key concepts.

study_help.modal_subtitle: How to rate your answers to maximize retention and optimal spacing
study_help.golden_rule_tip: 💡 Golden Rule: Be honest with your answers. FSRS learns from your real failures and successes to optimize spacing.
study_help.again_desc: Complete blank or wrong answer. ALWAYS choose this option when you fail so the algorithm records the lapse and repeats the card in this session.
study_help.hard_desc: Correct with great effort. You barely remembered it or hesitated significantly. DO NOT use if you got the question wrong.
study_help.good_desc: Normal and expected recall. This is the standard choice after a reasonable mental effort.
study_help.easy_desc: Instant recall without hesitation. Expands the interval to space it further in time.
